description: Read your own browser sessions: GET /api/v1/sessions (run.session-list-result@1), GET /api/v1/sessions/:id (run.session@1: state, where it runs, task_id, timings, desk-seconds) and GET /api/v1/sessions/:id/still (the desk's newest frame as a small JPEG, at most once a second, or the curtain picture while Curtain now is up). Never another person's: anyone else gets 404, a signed-out visitor included.
